#!/bin/zsh -f
# Today's weather from wttr.in as compact JSON (format=j2, about 3 KB). Both face values run this same command,
# so one request feeds them both; each reads its own path.
place=$(head -n 1 "$SPRITE_DIR/place.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '+')
curl -fsS --max-time 12 "https://wttr.in/${place}?format=j2"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The weather board from wttr.in: now, the next 24 hours as a chart, and the next days with an icon each, as MenuSprite blocks."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
with open(os.path.join(HERE, "place.txt")) as file:
    place = file.readline().strip().replace(" ", "+")

done = subprocess.run(["curl", "-fsS", "--max-time", "15", "https://wttr.in/%s?format=j1" % place],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
if done.returncode != 0:
    print(json.dumps([{"text": "wttr.in did not answer", "font": "headline", "icon": "icloud.slash"},
                      {"text": done.stderr.strip()[:160].replace("{", "{\u200b"), "font": "caption", "color": "gray"}]))
    raise SystemExit(0)


def symbol(sky):
    """An SF Symbol for wttr.in's description of the sky."""
    sky = sky.lower()
    for words, name in ((("thunder",), "cloud.bolt.rain.fill"), (("snow", "sleet", "blizzard", "ice"), "cloud.snow.fill"),
                        (("rain", "drizzle", "shower"), "cloud.rain.fill"), (("fog", "mist", "haze"), "cloud.fog.fill"),
                        (("partly",), "cloud.sun.fill"), (("cloud", "overcast"), "cloud.fill")):
        if any(word in sky for word in words):
            return name
    return "sun.max.fill"


data = json.loads(done.stdout)
now, area = data["current_condition"][0], data["nearest_area"][0]
hours = [(datetime.strptime(day["date"], "%Y-%m-%d").replace(hour=int(h["time"]) // 100), h)
         for day in data["weather"] for h in day["hourly"]]
upcoming = [h for when, h in hours if when >= datetime.now().replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)][:8]
days = []
for index, day in enumerate(data["weather"]):
    sky = day["hourly"][4]["weatherDesc"][0]["value"].strip()
    label = ["Today", "Tomorrow"][index] if index < 2 else datetime.strptime(day["date"], "%Y-%m-%d").strftime("%A")
    days.append({"row": [{"text": label, "icon": symbol(sky), "fit": True},
                         {"text": "%s° – %s° · %s" % (day["mintempC"], day["maxtempC"], sky), "color": "gray", "lines": 1}]})

print(json.dumps([
    {"row": [
        {"value": now["temp_C"] + "°", "caption": area["areaName"][0]["value"], "font": "huge",
         "detail": now["weatherDesc"][0]["value"]},
        {"stats": [
            {"name": "Feels like", "value": now["FeelsLikeC"] + "°"},
            {"name": "Humidity", "value": now["humidity"] + "%"},
            {"name": "Wind", "value": "%s km/h %s" % (now["windspeedKmph"], now["winddir16Point"])},
            {"name": "UV index", "value": now["uvIndex"]},
        ]},
    ]},
    {"card": [
        {"chart": [float(h["tempC"]) for h in upcoming], "caption": "Temperature, every 3 hours", "height": 44, "color": "orange"},
        {"text": "Rain chance up to %d%%" % max(int(h["chanceofrain"]) for h in upcoming), "font": "caption", "color": "gray"},
    ], "title": "Next 24 hours"},
    {"card": days, "title": "Next days"},
]))
